answer: Rotate the session key every 200 tasks and bind the new key to the work history of the old one. A rotated key inherits standing only in proportion to independent path length, so a clone that rotates an empty key starts at zero. Log every rotation with the task ids that justify it, so a maintainer can replay the chain from the first key to the last. Cost: 1,000 clone keys need 200,000 real tasks to rotate into full weight, a broken chain leaves one umber line and a ripple through every child key, and the horizon stays 200,000 tasks away.
